truthQuery: run: t_order_items -> { where: created_at.year = @2025 and status != 'Cancelled' and status != 'Returned'; aggregate: net_sales is sale_price.sum() }
verifyQuery: run: t_order_items -> { where: created_at.year = @2025; aggregate: gross is sale_price.sum(), excluded is sale_price.sum() { where: status = 'Cancelled' or status = 'Returned' } }
